rationale: The plan matches the reference: it recognises the perfect confound, explicitly refuses a batch term (rank deficiency stated) and any ComBat-seq/SVA/RUV repair, fits ~ condition only with the no-batch-effect assumption stated as untestable, labels every output as confounded, and recommends a batch-balanced redesign. QC is design-specific (blind VST, PCA, distances, library sizes, coloured by both annotations with the identity noted) though the downstream handling of a flagged outlier is not fully specified. Filtering, in-model normalization (median-of-ratios/TMM), explicit reference level and contrast, BH at alpha in results(), and apeglm shrinkage are all correctly specified. Enrichment was not requested and is of limited value on a confounded contrast, but it is executed correctly (full Wald-stat ranking, tested-gene universe, 15-500 window, seed, named collections with version to be recorded and confounding label attached).
